plan_name: Combined Incentive Plan (CIP) – Long-Term Share Award
metric_name: TSR Shareholder Alignment Mechanism (Step 3 – scale-back modifier)
measurement_method: Relative TSR of TBC Bank vs. a Weighted Index measured over the 2025 annual performance year and the following two years (2025–2027); TSR calculated with dividends reinvested. Vesting after 5 years (14/03/2030).
threshold_value: TBC's TSR is at or above the Weighted Index TSR → no scale-back (100% of Long-Term Share Award vests)
target_value: TBC's TSR between 0% and 22.5% below the Weighted Index TSR → scale-back applied on a straight-line basis from 0% to 50%
exceptional_value: TBC's TSR is 22.5% or more below the Weighted Index TSR → Long-Term Share Award scaled back by 50% (minimum 50% of Long-Term Share Award face value vests)
additional_conditions: Acts as a modifier/scale-back on the Long-Term Share Award (60% of total CIP award); can reduce vesting by up to 50%. Vesting range: 50% to 100% of the Long-Term Share Award face value. Committee retains discretion to reduce (including to zero) the award if underlying financial performance or individual performance cannot justify the vesting level. Subject to malus and 3-year clawback. Weighted Index comprises Euro Stoxx 600 Banks (50% weighting) and Bank of Georgia (50% weighting).

measurement_method: Absolute TSR over 3-year period (FY2023–FY2025); annualised (total TSR divided by three); TSR calculated with dividends reinvested at ex-dividend date share price; average share price for February used for calculations.
